fusions.name: Split Heels
fusions.desc: Kicks out with both hind hooves, loosing 2 bolts of force spread apart, each dealing 4 damage.

fusions.name: Two Ways at Once
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt into the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage, then branches to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of the damage. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +25%). Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Both Flanks
fusions.desc: Rears and challenges up to 2 enemies within 5 tiles, pulling them onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shying Sideways
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge rolls your dodge a second time, and the second roll stands.
